stories.headline: 'I've applied for more than 400 roles' - how young people are facing the job shortage
stories.summary: The BBC has been hearing from young people who are struggling to find work about how they are tackling the challenge.

voices.student_north: Bhai 400 applications? Rookie numbers. Hum toh 47 rejections ke baad bhi hope kar rahe hain ki koi ek company mein HR ko hamara resume accident se khul jayega. Placement cell ne bola — "Keep trying." Haan, trying se toh ghar ka rent bhi nahi banega, lekin accha lag raha hai.
voices.student_south: Bhai 400 applications? That's cute. Our seniors crossed 1000. LinkedIn pe "actively looking" likha hai — matlab desperate likha hai in corporate language. At least BBC wale log ko interview toh de rahe hain, hamare professor ne assignment ke 400 attempts mein pass nahi kiya abhi tak.
voices.professional_north: Bhai 400 applications, aur mila kya? Mere liye bhi same story — resume bhej, rejection aaye, repeat. Appraisal mein boss kahta hai "market mein bahut competition hai" — haan bhai, tu apna competition dekh le, 400 log teri naukri ke liye ladh rahe hain aur tere paas sirf ek resign letter hai.
voices.professional_south: Bhai, 400 applications matlab they've mastered the art of rejection better than our performance reviews. At least job portal rejections are honest — they don't smile and say "great work" before the layoff email. Apne kitne apply kiya? Or still waiting for that one magical recruiter who actually reads CVs?

voices.student_north: Bhai Paul McCartney 80 saal ka hai aur abhi bhi guitar sikhh raha hai new people se. Aur yahan hum placement ke liye LinkedIn pe "willing to learn" likha hai, fir bhi koi message nahi aata. Ye sab age mein seekha toh kisi ne appreciate nahi kiya.
voices.student_south: Paul McCartney says some guy played guitar better than him. Bhai, even legends are insecure now. Meanwhile you're struggling to remember your DSA assignment, and here's a 80-year-old worried about being outplayed. At least your professor won't write a memoir about how you disappointed him.
voices.professional_north: Yaar Paul McCartney ko guitar sikhana pad gaya ek actor se. Humein bhi yehi haal hai — boss ko PowerPoint banane padta hai, phir woh senior ko dikhaata hai ki ye to usne banaya tha. Experience aur talent ka koi matlab nahi, jo present kar sake woh God hai.
voices.professional_south: Yaar, Paul McCartney bol raha hai guitar player ko kuch nahi pata. Mere boss bhi aise hi — mujhe project dedeta hai, phir bol deta "tune galat kiya." Farak itna hi ki McCartney famous hai, mere boss sirf apne team mein infamous hai.

stories.headline: BBC News wins Emmy Award for coverage of Myanmar earthquake

voices.student_north: BBC ko Emmy mila Myanmar earthquake coverage ke liye. Bhaiya, humara placement news aata hai toh sirf WhatsApp status milta hai. Inhe international award, hume toh placement officer se ek "congratulations" message bhi nahi milega — bas final round ke baad silence aur LinkedIn doom scroll.
voices.student_south: BBC winning Emmy for earthquake coverage. Bhai, meanwhile our campus news WhatsApp group can't even report accurately when mess food gives food poisoning. They'll probably credit the wrong building. One day BBC will cover *our* placement season disaster and win another Emmy.
voices.professional_north: BBC ko Emmy mil gaya Myanmar earthquake coverage ke liye. Bhai, hamara boss toh apne desk se earthquake aane ka wait kar raha hai taaki work from home ban jaye. Isko bhi award dilwa do — "Best Performance Under Pressure" ka category khol do.

stories.headline: Matthew Perry's assistant jailed for 41 months over actor's ketamine death
stories.summary: Kenneth Iwamasa, who pleaded guilty last year to one count of conspiracy to distribute ketamine causing death, said he "will forever regret" his actions.

voices.student_north: Bhai, Matthew Perry ka assistant 41 months jail mein gaya ketamine ke liye. Aur humko placement mil nahi raha toh guilt nahi hai — bas CV reject hote hain. Ye toh literally Hollywood se jail gaya, humme toh sirf dad se scolding milti hai. Unfair advantage hai uska.
voices.student_south: Bhai, ek assistant ne ek actor ko kill kar diya ketamine se aur 41 months jail jaayega. Meanwhile, hamara professor jo har semester humko kill karta hai — usko kuch nahi hota. Appointment letter milne se pehle hi placement coordinator humko eliminate kar dega.
voices.professional_north: Yaar, assistant ne boss ka ketamine supply kiya aur 41 months jail ho gaya. Humara assistant toh boss ka coffee supply karta hai aur phir bhi apna job insecure lagta hai. Moral of the story — kisi ka bhi supply mat karna, apna hi supply theek se rok le.
voices.professional_south: Yaar, assistant ne boss ko ketamine diya aur jail gayi. Hamara assistant toh coffee deti hai — lekin uska bhi intention same hi hai, humko slow poison karna. Atleast isko 41 months jail mila, humein toh lifetime sentence hai — apna boss ke saath.

voices.student_south: Bad Bunny voice acting in Toy Story 5. Bro, even forgotten pizza toys getting better career prospects than us.
